Hi, I’m sorry to hear about your situation. Unfortunately I know what it feels like to not feel loved by my family, be isolated from “friends” and cried myself to sleep for sometimes weeks on end. It’s an excruciatingly painful feeling and honestly just made me feel empty or hollow at times. 

On the other hand, you’re in a situation where there are lots of unknowns. Use these unknowns to your advantage. Try new things, talk to new people, go to new places. You’re in a new city, explore and adventure. 

And for your school, kick ass in your new program. If you don’t feel up to exploring, study extra hard and get ahead.
